test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) AK - VH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e391081a075b9fb4e388b8d7c2ff14b8362c4092eee9d5081046685157e53ce5.png] 

Option 2) YI - TD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6ec6c8d10444fa8080e6a63d36a4d3c03c9895cafa7a781a74f2fd26c556a6.png] 

Option 3) SC - NX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c6890ecce9f1c4ca4957ad43e8dd66072b16a5a491f86fe20d9c7a84932af1.png] 

Option 4) LV - GQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7401d1dc4330c555dc83d104c33798b2690d9ba641c0f39cf79b2858c44160.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'AK - VH' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
